after.name: Question 2
after.worked_solution:
If we plug in $x=0$ we get the indeterminate form $\frac{0}{0},$ so  we apply L'Hopital's rule to find the limit:

$$
\begin{aligned}{lim}_{x\to 0}\frac{{e}^{x}-x-1}{\operatorname{cos}⁡x-1} & ={lim}_{x\to 0}\frac{[{e}^{x}-x-1]^{′}}{[\operatorname{cos}⁡x-1]^{′}} \\  & ={lim}_{x\to 0}\frac{{e}^{x}-1}{-\operatorname{sin}⁡x} \\  & =-{lim}_{x\to 0}\frac{{e}^{x}-1}{\operatorname{sin}⁡x}\end{aligned}
$$

This time, the resulting limit still gives the indeterminate form $\frac{0}{0}.$ To find the limit, we apply L'Hopital's rule once again. We get

$$
\begin{aligned}{lim}_{x\to 0}\frac{{e}^{x}-x-1}{\operatorname{cos}⁡x-1} & =-{lim}_{x\to 0}\frac{{e}^{x}-1}{\operatorname{sin}⁡x} \\  & =-{lim}_{x\to 0}\frac{[{e}^{x}-1]^{′}}{[\operatorname{sin}⁡x]^{′}} \\  & =-{lim}_{x\to 0}\frac{{e}^{x}}{\operatorname{cos}⁡x} \\  & =-\frac{{e}^{0}}{\operatorname{cos}⁡0} \\  & =-\frac{1}{1} \\  & =-1.\end{aligned}
$$

\begin{aligned}{lim}_{x\to 0}\frac{ln\,(1+\operatorname{sin}⁡(2x))-\operatorname{sin}⁡(2x)}{1-\operatorname{cos}⁡(3x)} & ={lim}_{x\to 0}\frac{{[ln\,(1+\operatorname{sin}⁡(2x))-\operatorname{sin}⁡(2x)]}^{′}}{[1-\operatorname{cos}⁡(3x)]^{′}} \\  & ={lim}_{x\to 0}\frac{\frac{2\operatorname{cos}⁡(2x)}{1+\operatorname{sin}⁡(2x)}-2\operatorname{cos}⁡(2x)}{3\operatorname{sin}⁡(3x)} \\  & =-\frac{2}{3}{lim}_{x\to 0}\frac{\operatorname{cos}⁡(2x)-\operatorname{cos}⁡(2x)(1+\operatorname{sin}⁡(2x))}{(1+\operatorname{sin}⁡(2x))\operatorname{sin}⁡(3x)} \\  & =-\frac{2}{3}{lim}_{x\to 0}\frac{\operatorname{cos}⁡(2x)\operatorname{sin}⁡(2x)}{(1+\operatorname{sin}⁡(2x))\operatorname{sin}⁡(3x)} \\  & =-\frac{2}{3}{lim}_{x\to 0}\frac{\frac{1}{2}\operatorname{sin}⁡(4x)}{(1+\operatorname{sin}⁡(2x))\operatorname{sin}⁡(3x)}\end{aligned}
$$

This time, the resulting limit still gives the indeterminate form $\frac{0}{0}.$ To find the limit, we apply L'Hopital's rule once again. We get

$$
\begin{aligned}{lim}_{x\to 0}\frac{ln\,(1+\operatorname{sin}⁡(2x))-\operatorname{sin}⁡(2x)}{1-\operatorname{cos}⁡(3x)} & =-\frac{2}{3}{lim}_{x\to 0}\frac{\frac{1}{2}\operatorname{sin}⁡(4x)}{(1+\operatorname{sin}⁡(2x))\operatorname{sin}⁡(3x)} \\  & =-\frac{2}{3}{lim}_{x\to 0}\frac{{[\frac{1}{2}\operatorname{sin}⁡(4x)]}^{′}}{{[(1+\operatorname{sin}⁡(2x))\operatorname{sin}⁡(3x)]}^{′}} \\  & =-\frac{2}{3}{lim}_{x\to 0}\frac{2\operatorname{cos}⁡(4x)}{2\operatorname{cos}⁡(2x)\operatorname{sin}⁡(3x)+3(1+\operatorname{sin}⁡(2x))\operatorname{cos}⁡(3x)} \\  & =-\frac{2}{3}\cdot \frac{2}{3} \\  & =-\frac{4}{9}.\end{aligned}
$$
